name: Kaiser Permanente South San Francisco High School Volunteer Program
city: South San Francisco, CA (1200 El Camino Real; also Daly City and San Bruno offices)
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors at the hospital or at nearby offices in Daly City and San Bruno. You work one 4 hour shift each week.
who_can_apply: High school students 16 years or older (the kp.org page says ages 16 to 17). Commit to one 4-hour shift a week, same day and time. The time commitment spans your high school career.
duration: One 4-hour shift a week, for the rest of high school
deadline_text: Not open to high school students right now. On 2026-10-16 the page said high school applications are accepted sporadically during the year based on shift availability, and that after a system upgrade it is taking a very limited number of applications, with adults 18+ applying to Hospital Services. No date is posted.
how_to_apply: Call Volunteer Services at 650-742-2678. Ask when high school spots will open. Then apply on the Kaiser volunteer site under South San Francisco.
notes: Read on Kaiser Permanente's volunteer site and the kp.org page on 2026-10-16. The kp.org page says a few hours a week for a few months, but the volunteer site says the high school commitment spans your high school career; plan on the longer one. The Daly City Medical Offices page has the same high school rules. Kaiser does not offer job or clinical shadowing. The page does not list vaccine, TB test or fee rules.
